messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Automated alert — sudden spike in 5xx for /v1/generate and /v1/chat across prod (us-east-1, us-west-2). Correlates with increased control-plane auth/org-lookup timeouts and billing validation errors. Current 5xx: 7.4% (baseline ~0.2%). Paging @maya @alex @priya. Please acknowledge and triage.

maya: ack I'm oncall, looking at traces + logs now. where are we seeing the auth timeouts?

alex: seeing org-lookup timeouts from controlplane proxy to org-service. 95th auth latency jumped to 2.8s, underlying call to org-lookup returns 504/timeouts.

priya: +1 logs show repeated `org-lookup request timed out` and a flurry of `token-validation` errors from billing svc. looks like a fanout cascade from auth.

sasha: tagging for context: we pushed config-rollout ~40m ago that changed orgcache eviction defaults to 30s. could be related.

maya: good catch @sasha. timeline: config rollout at -40m, error spike starting -35m. rolling back cache change is one mitigation.

alex: running quick check — health endpoints for org-service look green but p99 latency high. kubectl logs show `connection reset by peer` spiking.

maya: action plan: 1) enable fallback cache on controlplane auth proxy to reduce orgLookup calls 2) revert recent config rollout if rollback fast 3) add temporary circuit-breaker to stop fanout to billing 4) notify CS re customer impact.

priya: I'll prepare rollback patch for the config flag. quick command to revert (from deploy bot):
```
# rollback config rollout
kubectl -n controlplane set configmap org-cache-config --from-file=org-cache-defaults.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deployment/controlplane-proxy
```

alex: while priya prepares rollback, I can flip fallback cache on the proxy. config endpoint: `/admin/feature/fallback-cache` -> true. Doing now.

opsbot: action executed: POST /admin/feature/fallback-cache true — success 200 OK

maya: monitoring after fallback-cache flip. Dashboard: 5xx down to 4.8% from 7.4%, error waterfall shows reduced org-lookup calls. still elevated but improving.

priya: rollback applied and restarted controlplane-proxy. verifying rollout status... `kubectl rollout status deployment/controlplane-proxy -n controlplane` -> done.

alex: good. 5xx trending down to 2.2%. but billing token validations still showing occasional 502s. looks like downstream backpressure.

maya: mitigation step: enable degrade-mode for billing validation — short-circuit non-blocking checks for trusted partners to avoid blocking requests. Priya/pls coordinate with billing team to toggle.

priya: pinging billing on #eng-platform-billing, they ack and will flip degrade flag.

opsbot: billing-service: feature toggle `validation.degrade_mode=true` set by priya — 200 OK

maya: after degrade-mode, 5xx at 0.9%. customer-impact check: which customers hit hard? alex, can you pull top failing orgs?

alex: pulled top orgs by failed requests last 15m: org-124 (external API heavy), org-87 (SaaS partner), org-999 (trial). I'll open an incident ticket for SRE to notify CS for those orgs.

alex: creating ticket ENG-INC-5123 with failure counts and approximate start time 3115010000. linking logs and sample traces.

sasha: note: we do have degraded latency for admin paths while cache warming; expect errors to be transient. We should keep fallback-cache and degrade-mode until full warmup ~+30m.

maya: agree. leaving fallback-cache on and degrade-mode on. monitoring for 30m, then plan phased rollback of mitigations if stable.

priya: quick summary for pager handoff: root cause appears to be config change that lowered effective cache TTL leading to org-lookup stampede and downstream billing validation timeouts. mitigation: fallback-cache enabled, config rollback, billing degrade-mode. Current status: error-rate reduced to ~0.9%, system stabilizing.

maya: I need to escalate to shift lead and handoff to @tom for overnight monitoring. tagging SRE lead. tom are you able to take the remainder?

tom: I can take over. thanks @maya. I'll keep watch and coordinate with billing if any regression. handoff note: mitigations in place, keep fallback-cache=true, validation.degrade_mode=true until 2026-03-15T05:00Z or until confirmed stable.

maya: handing off now. full context: logs, traces, deploy IDs, rollback commit (sha: 9f4a2b7) attached in ticket. notify CS for top affected orgs and prepare customer messages if regression.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall maya -> tom at 3115017200. Severity P1 -> Reduced to P2 for monitoring.

tom: ack handoff. I'll run periodic checks, alert if 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 5m. Also will coordinate with product for postmortem timeline.

maya: thanks team. postmortem action items: (1) add safety for cache TTL rollouts (canary + gradual ramp) (2) add early anomaly detection for org-lookup fanout (3) improve circuit-breaker defaults for billing. I'll create follow-up tickets. :white_check_mark:

priya: copying summary to #incidents-summary and pinging CS for customer comms.

sasha: will add a rule to rollout pipeline to block TTL drops below 60s without canary.

tom: I'll monitor next 2 hours and then close this thread once stable. leaving notes in ENG-INC-5123.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed by tom at 3115018410 (monitoring phase).
